title: Online battle-royale game, player-facing flows
provenance: OWASP Threat Model Cookbook, "Battle Royale Game Flow Diagram" (Flow Diagram/online-battleroyale-game/onlinegame.py, pytm), https://github.com/OWASP/threat-model-cookbook — textual and graphical representations CC-BY 4.0. Converted to submitted-text form for this corpus.
notes: Cookbook conversion 2 of 2. The full source diagram is 32 elements, over the 8-20 band that makes ground truth exhaustively enumerable (ticket 009 decision 5), so this case converts a deliberately scoped subset: the player path (client, lobby, game servers, both databases) plus the support/moderation path. Dropped from the source diagram: the anonymous web user, the stats website, and the REST API behind it — a self-contained web sub-tree whose removal changes no remaining element's attributes. Far from the payments exemplar in the way that matters most for the delta: the untrusted element is a process running the operator's own code on hardware the operator does not control, which is a trust shape the exemplar has no instance of at all.
